citations.assessment: Heilprin’s text and the checked Bavli give opposite assignments. Preserve the source’s statement and append an explicitly attributed correction based on the Bavli.
Rosh’s first chapter explicitly gives the full name and the chain in Rav Avya’s name before Ravina. The folio is Heilprin’s locator and the hyperlink targets the text directly.
The Bavli on 10b names only Rav Sama in this ruling. The more specific patronymic and the Rav Avya chain are in the Rosh witness.

holds.reason: The digital Bavli confirms the bare Rav Sama reading. Identification of the exact printing behind the provisionally expanded siglum remains open.
